# United Rubber Cork — full content reference

## Company

United Rubber Cork supplies cork and rubberised cork products for industrial,
construction and insulation, decorative, and gifting applications. The
company is based in GIDC, Vapi, Gujarat, India.

The documented audiences include transformer manufacturers, automotive
component makers, construction and insulation buyers, and decorative buyers.
This does not establish shipping destinations or geographic service coverage.
Export capability has not been confirmed.

## Products and published specifications

### Rubberised cork

The range includes sheets, gaskets, frames, strips and washers.

- Sheets: 1.0 to 20 mm thick; sizes 2 ft x 3 ft, 3 ft x 3 ft and
  1000 x 1000 mm.
- Strips: 20 to 600 mm wide and 1 to 10 mm thick.
- Gaskets and components: can be discussed against a customer drawing or
  sample, or to IS 4253 Part II.

### Cork

The documented range includes sheets and rolls, rings and gaskets, polishing
wheels, granules, anti-vibration slabs, Battricork and stoppers. Published
granule mesh sizes are 0.2/0.5, 0.5/1, 1/2, 3/4 and 4/8 mm. Other dimensions and
availability should be confirmed.

### Decorative cork

Tiles are listed in 300 x 300 mm and 600 x 600 mm face sizes, 3 to 12 mm thick.
Memo board dimensions, finishes and availability should be confirmed.

### Cork gifts

The current range, dimensions and quantities are available by enquiry; details
are not documented here.

## Applications

- Transformers: rubberised cork strips and gaskets; gaskets can be discussed
  against a customer drawing or sample.
- Automotive: rubberised cork gaskets, frames and washers.
- Construction and insulation: cork sheets, granules and anti-vibration slabs.

Application information is not a substitute for confirming the material and
dimensions required for a specific design.

## Standards and quality

Rubberised cork products are listed as made to IS 4253 Part II or customer
requirements. Existing company information identifies ISO 9001:2015, but
certificate ownership and current certificate details have not been confirmed
for United Rubber Cork. Request current documentation before relying on
certification, test results or performance claims.

## Contact and quote process

The address, phone numbers and mailbox addresses published on the website were
carried over from the previous brand and have not yet been confirmed for
United Rubber Cork. Refer to [contact.md](/contact) for those details and the
confirmation caveat.

The website does not currently store or submit quote requests. Its email link
opens a draft in the visitor's email application; the visitor must review and
send the message. There is no confirmed WhatsApp number, online upload, price
list, minimum order quantity, lead-time promise, export coverage or approved
datasheet library.
